caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is titled Leading music apps in the Apple App Store in the Netherlands in September 2020 , by number of downloads (in 1,000s). A linear scale of range 0 to 40 can be found on the x-axis, marked Number of downloads in thousands. There is a categorical scale starting at 538 and ending at YouTube Music along the y-axis, marked Music Apps.
caption_L2L3: The bigger brand name apps appear to have much greater download numbers. These are over 30,000 each whilst the more localised apps appear to have a much lower number of customer downloads, perhaps showing that they are more niche music apps.
